headline: A 2014 law names a Dublin, Ohio post office after two military members, Lance Corporal Wesley G. Davids and Captain Nicholas J. Rozanski.
what_it_does: The law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 715 Shawan Falls Drive in Dublin, Ohio, as the Lance Corporal Wesley G. Davids and Captain Nicholas J. Rozanski Memorial Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or fees.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
